notes.title: Saloon Simulator is now available in Early Access!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear players,[/h3]

Saloon Simulator is kicking off its life as an Early Access game! We have big plans for the project and we want to shape them around your preferences and ideas. Over the next few months, we’ll be paying very close attention to your feedback—both here on Steam and over on our [b]Discord server[/b], where you’re warmly invited to join the conversation.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1876930/Saloon_Simulator/

[h3]What’s included in the current Early Access version?[/h3]

[list]
[*] 34 quests that introduce the residents of Blueberry, the work of a saloon keeper, and all the mechanics and minigames we've built
[*] Expanded saloon management with rentable rooms and a full-fledged gambling den
[*] A robust Freeplay mode
[*] Brand-new furniture and decorative elements
[*] 2 new minigames: gold panning and unloading the train
[*] Full English voice-over performed by professional actors
[/list]
...and much, much more!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHZDPvG2HE8

While this version of the game has been thoroughly tested for over two months, you may still encounter bugs—we’ll be spending the upcoming weeks fixing and polishing based on your reports. Please don’t hesitate to let us know about any issues here on Steam or via Discord.

Early Access is a development phase—not a finished product. Our entire team will continue working on the game for many more months. We’ll be sharing our progress with you through [b]monthly devlogs[/b] here on Steam and on our Discord channel.

[h3]FAQ[/h3]

I’ve tried to answer most of your questions in the FAQ section on our Discord. But in case you’d rather not join just yet, here they are:

[b]I’m a content creator and would like a key to stream the game. What should I do?[/b]
Go to [https://rockgame.pl], click the “Request a Key” button in the top right corner, and select “Saloon Simulator” in the survey. Once you submit the form and meet the requirements, you should receive your key.
[b]
Do you plan to add a co-op mode?[/b]
Unfortunately, we don’t have any plans for that. Saloon was designed from the very beginning as a single-player experience, and adding online multiplayer would require rebuilding the core game code.

[b]I have access to Saloon Simulator Playtest but can’t launch it. Why?[/b]
Playtests are specific builds we released during development. The latest version available is the Saloon Simulator Prologue, which is an improved and polished build that you may have seen in the last playtests. I encourage you to try the Saloon Simulator Prologue—it’s completely free!

Saloon Simulator was created out of a deep love for the Wild West atmosphere. We truly hope that your visit to Blueberry will let you see it not just as it is—but as it could one day become.

As the Polish poetic duo Olga and Rafał Golec once said, words that guide our production more than you might think:

[i]Tu na razie jest ściernisko
Ale będzie San Francisco
A tam, gdzie to kretowisko
Będzie stał mój bank[/i]

[quote]Which roughly translates to:
[i]Right now, it's just a barren field
But soon it'll be San Francisco
And where there’s just a molehill now—
That's where my bank will stand[/i][/quote]

[h3]Join Our Discord![/h3]
We also invite you to join our Discord, where we answer all your questions. If you have anything you’d like to share with us, that’s the place to do it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508967/66e7e4a3587b6ea767c2ef3718da294bc1d480d8.png[/img]
https://discord.gg/sfVazZ23Zz

Once again—thank you all so much for the support and feedback you’ve shared with us so far. We can’t wait to hear what you think of the Early Access release!

notes.title: Saloon Simulator Prologue 2.0 – Big Update!
notes.content:
Howdy, partners!

[h3]Get ready for the biggest version of our game yet – Saloon Simulator is launching into Early Access on July 15, 2025![/h3]

To get y’all excited for the return to Blueberry and sweeten the wait a bit, we’ve prepared a major update to the Saloon Simulator Prologue.

Here’s what’s new in version 2.0:

[list]
[*] Full English voice-over performed by professional actors
[*] An expanded game intro that reveals how Cheyenne arrived in town and the conditions under which he took over the saloon
[*] Visual improvements – better character animations during conversations and pedestrians on the streets
[*] Brand new music tracks
[*] Improved translations and more in-depth game options (including option to keybind remapping)
[*] Horses! (Because what’s a Wild West game without horses?)
[/list]
…And plenty more fixes, tweaks, and surprises we’ve worked on over the past year!
We highly encourage you to replay the Prologue before the Early Access release – now’s the perfect time!

A couple important disclaimers:

Although the updated Prologue now includes a freeplay mode where you can continue serving guests and customizing your saloon, [b]save files will not transfer to the Early Access version[/b]. That means your in-game cash and progress from the Prologue won’t carry over – you’ll need to start fresh when you jump into EA.

The previous Prologue version (released a year ago) included more narrative and quest content than the version we’re releasing today. But don’t worry – that doesn’t mean the EA version is just the old Prologue with voice-over and a few upgrades.
On the contrary, the EA version [b]more than doubles the story content[/b], adds tons of new quests, several new characters, and two minigames.
Back then, we gave you everything we had. Now, we know that slice was a bit too big, so we’ve trimmed the Prologue to make it more streamlined, easier to complete in one sitting, and less spoiler-filled.
We hope the many improvements we’ve added will make up for the shorter runtime.

[b]Come join us on Discord!
[/b]It’s the best place to get the latest updates, chat with the devs, suggest features, or report any bugs you find.

https://discord.gg/sfVazZ23Zz

Let the whiskey flow, the ragtime roll, and the pistols stay in their holsters—
It’s gonna be a mighty fine afternoon at the Blueberry Saloon!

Krzysztof "xardi" Marchewka
from the Saloon Simulator Team

notes.title: Hotfix 2 Saloon Simulator Prologue
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Players,
[/h1]
Thank you very much for the positive reception of Saloon Simulator Prologue! Over the past year, Blueberry has become a second home for us, and although we know it will take some time before it becomes a fully-fledged place, we are glad that you have already been able to enjoy your time there. This past week has been focused on optimization and fixing bugs that have hindered your gameplay experience. We have managed to fix several issues, and here is the list:

[h2]Fixed:
[/h2]- [b]Crashes during customization:[/b] Some players experienced crashes when performing a specific sequence of actions during saloon arrangement. We have identified and eliminated the cause of this issue.
- [b]Crashes in the store:[/b] The game would crash while browsing the store.
- [b]Save system:[/b] Fixed an issue that caused corrupted save files and applied fixes to some quests that were not saving correctly.
- [b]Negative ice cube count:[/b] In some cases, ice was disappearing from the icebox instead of generating.
- [b]Duplicating trash:[/b] Trash would reappear after loading the game.
-[b] Incorrect item counting in the store:[/b] Fixed errors in item counting within the store.
- [b]Quest items return: [/b]Items discarded by the player that were important for quests now return to the player.

[h2]Adjusted/Improved:
[/h2]- [b]More readable markers[/b]
-[b] Store UI: [/b]Updated the store's user interface.
- [b]Store item removal:[/b] Removed items from the store that cannot be customized in the prologue and added a few new ones.
- [b]Missing NPC animations: [/b]Added several missing animations during conversations with NPCs.

notes.title: Hotfix 1 Saloon Simulator prologue
notes.content:
Dear players!

We updated our prologue build with some fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*] Motion blur option has been added
[*] Mouse sensitivity option has been adjusted
[*] Hint about making drink for W. has been added
[*] Tutorial with ice box is shown when player for the first time take ice box
[*] Few save/load improvements
[*] Few improvements and bug fixes in the quests
[/list]

Thank you for your time and patience! Have fun!

Best, Glivi Games team!
